_meta.description: Master CDI Layer index. Points to all 10 domain files. Updated via cdi_update.py only.
_meta.uptime_requirement: ≥ 99.9% — this is a continuously running system-wide layer, not a per-task evaluation
_meta.update_policy: All updates route through cdi_update.py. Direct writes to any index file are forbidden and will trigger a Diagnostic Agent L1 failure.

reasoning_frameworks.description: 7 reasoning modes with activation states and usage counts

disciplinary_methods.description: 8 cross-disciplinary knowledge domains with analytics translations

inference_layers.description: Real-time L1-L5 status, current veto states, active signals

cross_domain_analogues.description: Problem-structure-keyed index of solved problems from adjacent fields

external_knowledge.description: Live external intelligence signals indexed by topic and relevance

second_brain_signal.description: Current Second Brain state — recent additions, high-similarity clusters, open constraints

exemplar_surface.description: Few-Shot Bank state — active exemplars, query classes, recency/relevance scores

phase7_signals.description: Phase 7 bottleneck candidates and cross-phase improvement patterns

non_activation_log.description: Log of which CDI capabilities were NOT queried per agent/phase — input to Phase 7 blind spot detection

design_system.description: Maldros Visual Design System (C-031) — palette, typography, communication pattern, information hierarchy, chart construction rules. Queried by any agent producing visual output.
design_system.non_activation_consequence: Diagnostic Agent L1 failure when the task produces a visual artifact

capability_expansion_properties.description: 5 binding operational requirements. Omission of any required CDI query = Diagnostic Agent L1 failure.

update_triggers: New entry added to Second Brain vault
New Telemetry Exemplar promoted to Few-Shot Bank
External retrieval produces new cross-domain analogue or external knowledge signal
New Constraint Register entry opened or closed
Phase 7 identifies new cross-phase bottleneck pattern
